hierarchy.rule: Later case-specific order controls over earlier case-specific order.
Case-specific order controls over judge/part rule.
Justice Tracy Catapano-Fox Medical, Dental and Podiatric Malpractice Part rules control over general Queens/court-wide practice where more specific and valid.

NYSCEF rules apply to e-filing and e-service mechanics.
CPLR/statutes are legal baseline and cannot be contradicted by lower authority.
